messages:
Sarah: Customer reports promo code "MAYDAY2024" failing at checkout with error 'promo_invalid (PROMO_EXPIRED)'. They say they tried at 11:50 PM local. Can someone take a look?

Alex: Which region/timezone is the user in and do we have the request id or client log? Web or API?

Sarah: User email: riley.p+trial@example.com, timezone Pacific (PDT). Web checkout. Client console shows: 
```
{ "error": "promo_invalid", "reason": "PROMO_EXPIRED", "server_time": "2024-05-01T07:02:15Z", "code": "MAYDAY2024" }
```

Jordan: Looking at the promos table: MAYDAY2024.expires_at = "2024-05-01T07:00:00Z" and promo.display_end_of_day = true, promo.timezone = "America/Los_Angeles". Marketing probably expected "end of day PDT" but expires_at is stored as UTC midnight shifted.

Megan: Yep, we've seen this pattern. Frontend displays "Expires May 1 (your local time)" because of display_end_of_day, which is misleading when expires_at was set to UTC midnight. Backend compares nowUtc <= expires_at, so customers in the Americas can lose minutes/hours around rollover.

Alex: I reproduced this in staging by setting my clock to 23:58 PDT. Redeem endpoint returns PROMO_EXPIRED when server UTC has passed stored expires_at. Curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout/redeem -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test...' -d '{"code":"MAYDAY2024","email":"riley.p+trial@example.com"}'
# -> {"error":"promo_invalid","reason":"PROMO_EXPIRED","server_time":"2024-05-01T07:02:30Z"}
```

Support Ops: For impacted customers, we can issue a one-time manual credit via admin: 
```
POST /admin/credits/grant
{ "email": "riley.p+trial@example.com", "amount_usd": 15, "reason": "manual make-good for promo timezone cutoff" }
```
I applied it for tx id tx_manual_44 and emailed the customer.

Jordan: Proposed fix (short): when promo.display_end_of_day == true and promo.timezone is set, compute promo_end_date at promo.timezone and accept redemptions until that local date's 23:59:59. Will add unit tests for DST edgecases. Filed ticket RN-3712.

Megan: Also flagged to marketing so new promos either set expires_at to correct local end-of-day UTC or we set a server-side toggle that enforces local end-of-day semantics.

Sarah: Customer confirmed credit applied and upgrade completed. Marking support case closed. Please add status updates to RN-3712 when available. Thanks all :thumbsup:
